question: Shri Lal Bahadur Shastri National Sanskrit University is located in ______ .
solution:
The correct answer is "__**New Delhi**__".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **New Delhi**, India, there is a central university known as **Shri Lal Bahadur Shastri National Sanskrit University**, formerly known as Shri Lal Bahadur Shastri Rashtriya Sanskrit Vidyapeetha.
 
• The **Vidyapeetha** was founded on **October 8, 1962**, and in November 1987, the **University Grants Commission** accorded it the status of a declared university.
 
• University provides various **Scholarships** to Students under various categories-​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Saroj Institute of Technology and Management **is located in Lucknow.
 
• **Jaipur National University** is located in Jaipur.
 
• **Bharati Vidyapeeth Deemed University **is located in Pune.
